classification: One new endpoint-first current-input construction; no physical admission from solver exit
target: lean_center original measured standing rear camera and box armchair back
new_mechanism: Exact forward kinematic/force/torque derivatives and active observed-material camera row derivatives replace SLSQP finite-difference Jacobians. Same fixed-material contact mode, original analytic seed, values/objective/60iterations/ftol/gates. Pre-optimizer independent original-model central differences reject a wrong derivative implementation.
initialization: Unchanged analytic current-input seed, then freeze its exposed contact material. No failed solution, vector or multiplier is read.

equations.equilibrium: sum F=[0,0,W]; sum p cross F = COM cross [0,0,W]; full23joint gravity minus fixed-material contact Jacobian torque
equations.contact: Endpoint point = root*FK(body)*constant local material; every body vertex remains nonpenetrating and endpoint point lies on observed plane. Load transfer uses that same material. Marker comes only from the original analytic seed; unloaded backward approach retains exposed-min geometry.
equations.objective: full23joint squared torque / original standing torque + readiness epigraph squared + .05 joint deviation squared + .05 fixed-material tangent error squared / .15^2 + normalized root lowering squared; backward connection adds .1 endpoint-guided posture distance squared + .01 interval seconds
equations.clock: joint command arc/.125; normal joint arc/.05 and .003/.0055 per normal edge; 0.5s explicit quiet reserve plus actual25CURRENT requirement; >=.25s/load edge; 1s settle; complete settled trajectory<14.4s
equations.optimization: SLSQP60iterations per named endpoint/edge,ftol1e-9; success mandatory, equality<=.002 and inequality>=-1e-6; total parent45s cap overrides all stages

resources.timeout_output: process receipt and already written seed/endpoint audit; no salvaged point admission

finite_return: Reject unless complete path, fullmesh, between-node feet/normal speed, float32 action bounds/filter/fingers and hold reserve pass; current-input runtime, ankle quiet and actual physical fullrollout gates still separately required.
limitations: Quasi-static model is not realized balance or contact force
ImplicitPD torque proxy is not physical energy
Sampled audit is not continuous geometry proof
Same-pose load transfer is a restriction; failure is not robot impossibility
Raw joint velocity guards remain unchanged
No simulation/PPO autostart on model pass
Exact derivatives may not resolve constrained optimization; failure remains reject, no retry/resume or iteration increase.

derivatives.FK: Forward chain-rule derivative of original root rotation-vector and joint-axis transforms; full23active joints plus6floatingbase coordinates
derivatives.forces: Differentiate exact full6D equilibrium and both foot force allocations; no force or motor sensor claimed
derivatives.torque: Differentiate all23 gravity and material-fixed contact moments including axes/origins/CoM/force points and forces
derivatives.feet: Original position and rotation-log errors via exact SO3 right Jacobian inverse
derivatives.camera: At every callback recompute actual per-body minimum sample and its observed facet from saved current depth; derivative of selected material point signed plane distance. Row values must match original compressed rows to1e-10. Unknown rows derivative0, no free-space claim. Nonsmooth ties retain a piecewise derivative; no averaging or margin relaxation.
derivatives.prelaunch_synthetic: Independent SciPy rotation and logarithm central differences at zero and nonzero rotations
derivatives.scientific_pre_solve_audit: Central differences of ORIGINAL model at original analytic seed: all23torques,12footerrors,3materialpointcomponents vs exactJac; maximumabsolute<2e-5,scaled<2e-6,objectivegradient<2e-5. These are derivative implementation checks, not changed feasibility tolerances.
